nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the representation number $r_k(n)$ equals the number of elements of the finite solution set of integer vectors $(x_1, \dots, x_k) \in \mathbb{Z}^k$ with $x_1^2 + \cdots + x_k^2 = n$.
nodes.title: The representation number counts a finite set

nodes.summary: The representation number $r_1(0)$, the number of integer vectors $x \in \mathbb{Z}^1$ with $x_1^2 = 0$, equals $1$.
nodes.title: Zero as a sum of one square

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 1$, the representation number $r_0(n)$, the number of integer vectors $x \in \mathbb{Z}^0$ whose sum of squares (an empty sum) equals $n$, is $0$.
nodes.title: Positive integers have no representation as a sum of zero squares

nodes.summary: The representation number $r_0(0)$, the number of integer vectors $x \in \mathbb{Z}^0$ whose sum of squares (an empty sum) equals $0$, is $1$.
nodes.title: Zero as a sum of zero squares

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the representation number $r_k(n)$ is the number of elements of the solution set, that is, the number of integer vectors $(x_1, \dots, x_k) \in \mathbb{Z}^k$ with $x_1^2 + \cdots + x_k^2 = n$. Representations that differ in the order or the signs of the entries are counted separately.
nodes.title: Representation numbers of sums of squares

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $k$ and $n$, there are only finitely many integer vectors $(x_1, \dots, x_k) \in \mathbb{Z}^k$ with $x_1^2 + \cdots + x_k^2 = n$.
nodes.title: Finitely many representations as a sum of squares

nodes.summary: The set of vectors $x \in \mathbb{Z}^1$ with $x_1^2 = 0$ consists of the zero vector alone.
nodes.title: Solution set of one square equal to zero

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 1$, no vector $x \in \mathbb{Z}^0$ has sum of squares equal to $n$; that is, the solution set is empty.
nodes.title: Zero squares never sum to a positive integer

nodes.summary: The set of vectors $x \in \mathbb{Z}^0$ whose sum of squares (an empty sum) equals $0$ is all of $\mathbb{Z}^0$.
nodes.title: Solution set of the empty sum at zero

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the solution set is the set of all integer vectors $x = (x_1, \dots, x_k) \in \mathbb{Z}^k$ with $x_1^2 + \cdots + x_k^2 = n$.
nodes.title: Integer solutions of a sum of squares

nodes.summary: For every $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the zero vector of $\mathbb{Z}^k$ has squared norm $0$, that is, it lies in the set of integer vectors $x \in \mathbb{Z}^k$ with $x_1^2 + \cdots + x_k^2 = 0$.
nodes.title: The zero vector represents zero as a sum of squares

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
